problem_text:
A logistics coordinator must allocate a series of distinct shipments onto identical cargo planes. The shipments are as follows:

* Shipment Alpha: mass 47 tonnes
* Shipment Beta: mass 39 tonnes
* Shipment Gamma: mass 61 tonnes
* Shipment Delta: mass 43 tonnes
* Shipment Epsilon: mass 44 tonnes
* Shipment Zeta: mass 51 tonnes
* Shipment Eta: mass 35 tonnes
* Shipment Theta: mass 36 tonnes
* Shipment Iota: mass 46 tonnes
* Shipment Kappa: mass 61 tonnes
* Shipment Lambda: mass 59 tonnes
* Shipment Mu: mass 49 tonnes
* Shipment Nu: mass 56 tonnes
* Shipment Xi: mass 53 tonnes
* Shipment Omicron: mass 67 tonnes
* Shipment Pi: mass 64 tonnes
* Shipment Rho: mass 41 tonnes
* Shipment Sigma: mass 35 tonnes
* Shipment Tau: mass 37 tonnes
* Shipment Upsilon: mass 38 tonnes
* Shipment Phi: mass 55 tonnes
* Shipment Chi: mass 47 tonnes
* Shipment Psi: mass 35 tonnes
* Shipment Omega: mass 64 tonnes
* Shipment Asterisk: mass 67 tonnes
* Shipment Caret: mass 48 tonnes
* Shipment BraceL: mass 63 tonnes
* Shipment BraceR: mass 40 tonnes
* Shipment Tilde: mass 60 tonnes
* Shipment Underscore: mass 56 tonnes
* Shipment Grave: mass 45 tonnes
* Shipment Pipe: mass 53 tonnes
* Shipment Section: mass 47 tonnes
* Shipment Paragraph: mass 47 tonnes
* Shipment Plus: mass 51 tonnes
* Shipment Minus: mass 41 tonnes
* Shipment Equal: mass 46 tonnes
* Shipment Ampersand: mass 43 tonnes
* Shipment Percent: mass 36 tonnes
* Shipment Dollar: mass 48 tonnes

Each aircraft possesses a maximum payload capacity of 100 tonnes. The objective is to assign every shipment to a specific plane, ensuring the cumulative mass on any given aircraft does not surpass its limit, while simultaneously minimizing the total number of planes required for the entire operation.
